verified_facts.text: The resort is an oceanfront hideaway overlooking the white-sand beaches of the Riviera Maya, off the beaten path.
verified_facts.excerpt: Off the beaten path, an oceanfront hideaway beckons, overlooking the white-sand beaches of the Riviera Maya.

verified_facts.text: Tulum International Airport (TQO) is about 65 km (40.6 miles) away and Cancun International Airport (CUN) about 96 km (59.5 miles) away.
verified_facts.excerpt: The nearest airport, Tulum International Airport (TQO), is 40.6 miles (65 km) away and Cancun International Airport (CUN), is 59.5 miles (96 km) away, approximately.

verified_facts.text: Self-parking and valet parking are available for guests with vehicles.
verified_facts.excerpt: Self-parking and valet parking are available for guests with vehicles.

verified_facts.text: Ancient ruins, natural wonders and other Riviera Maya attractions are within a half-hour's drive.
verified_facts.excerpt: Find ancient ruins, natural wonders, and endless Riviera Maya attractions within a half-hour’s drive.

verified_facts.text: Wooden entrance doors pivot open onto a breezy lobby with a layered water view: ornamental pools, then the main central pool, then the Caribbean Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lumbering wooden doors are pivoted open to reveal the breezy hotel lobby and create a view with layers of water, first the still ornamental pools, then the main central pool and finally the glowing Caribbean sea.

verified_facts.text: Rooms are spread across three blocks, each with its own central pool with a pool bar and full service.
verified_facts.excerpt: rooms are spread across three different blocks, each block with their own central pool with pool bar and full service

verified_facts.text: Ocean-facing rooms have hot tubs built into the balconies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ocean-facing rooms have hot tubs built into the balconies

verified_facts.text: Rooms have large white beds, hand-painted artworks that echo the colors outside, and rattan chandeliers.
verified_facts.excerpt: The rooms themselves are cool and clean, with large white beds, hand-painted art works that pull in from the palette outside, and rattan chandeliers.

verified_facts.text: There are nine places to eat.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are nine different places to eat

verified_facts.text: Autor is the resort's fine Mexican dining venue.
verified_facts.excerpt: Autor, the fine Mexican dining venue

verified_facts.text: Kengai is the resort's Japanese restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kengai, the Japanese spot

verified_facts.text: The spa is built from local natural rock and timber.
verified_facts.excerpt: The spa is a huge selling point, constructed from natural rock and timbers in the area.

verified_facts.text: The spa's central lounge is designed like a cenote, with sunlight coming through a large opening in the dome.
verified_facts.excerpt: The central lounge is designed like a cenote, with sunlight flooding in through a huge opening in the dome

verified_facts.text: The spa has treatment casitas and offers a four-hands traditional Mayan massage.
verified_facts.excerpt: I opted for a four hands traditional Mayan massage

verified_facts.text: The resort is about 30 minutes from Tulum.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests are about 30 minutes away from Tulum

verified_facts.text: There are cenotes and hiking trails in the area, and the hotel can help guests access them.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are also cenotes in the area as well as hiking trails which the hotel can help you access as well.

verified_facts.text: The team is made up of local workers at all levels of the business.
verified_facts.excerpt: pulling together a team of local workers at all levels of the business

verified_facts.text: The Conrad franchise rights belong to a Mexican couple, which helps explain the resort's local touches.
verified_facts.excerpt: they sold the franchise rights to a Mexican couple which may explain why this resort does such a good job of marrying the bells and whistles you'd expect of the brand with local touches

verified_facts.text: The Conrad is the more intimate, higher-end property within a larger Hilton complex on the coast.
verified_facts.excerpt: It's the more intimate and high-end property for the Hilton complex on the coast

verified_facts.text: There are lower-level rooms with accessible showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are lower-level rooms with accessible showers.

verified_facts.text: Lobby steps lead down to the main pool, which makes getting there with a stroller less convenient.
verified_facts.excerpt: I struggled getting my stroller up and down the lobby steps to get to the main pool

verified_facts.text: The resort was named in Conde Nast Traveler's Readers' Choice Awards 2022 through 2026.
verified_facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026

subjective.text: Pools, beach and burgers make the resort a hit with kids.
subjective.reason: the hotel's own opinion or praise; keep out of facts
